label: prop-basic-properties-of-the-power-set-retry
tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: Checked \(a = \varnothing\) with arbitrary \(b\), \(a = b = \varnothing\), and \(a,b\) with neither a subset of the other; all claims (i)–(viii) hold. Verified that \(\mathcal{P}(a) \neq \varnothing\) always, so \(\bigcap\mathcal{P}(a)\) is defined; \(\bigcup\mathcal{P}(\varnothing)=\varnothing\) and \(\bigcap\mathcal{P}(\varnothing)=\varnothing\). Both directions of the “if and only if”s in (iii) and (viii) were tested against the proofs and edge cases. No counterexample found.

CHECKED: Read every numbered step (1.1–3.1) and every fact [L1]–[L12]; compared each fact against the full text of its cited dependency. All facts are faithful, and every step is mathematically licensed by the facts it invokes. The proof of (viii) correctly uses the assumption of equality to force \(a\cup b\subseteq a\) or \(a\cup b\subseteq b\) and derives the disjunction. No unlicensed inference, missing hypothesis, or circularity detected.
